purpose: Teach: 農協/アポ/故に/計り/交差/つかめ/生後/下流

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、地方農協の協同組合史、丁寧でしたね。
lines.en: Your paper on regional agricultural cooperative history was really thoughtful.
lines.style: Steady, appreciative. A light pause before naming the topic — genuinely considering what she's read. Warm but professional, the tone of a teacher who means her praise.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。アポ取りに、時間が掛かりました。
lines.en: Yes. Getting those interviews set up took a lot of time.
lines.style: Modest, slightly self-conscious. A small breath before the admission. Quiet earnestness — not making excuses, just explaining what was hard.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 資料、未公開故に、貴重ですね。
lines.en: The materials were unpublished, which made them genuinely valuable.
lines.style: Leaning forward slightly. Noticing aloud. Clear appreciation for the work behind the access, not just the content itself.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。データ、計りに掛けるのは、難航しました。
lines.en: Yes. Analyzing that data was really difficult.
lines.style: Slight hesitation — searching for the right words. A little vulnerability in admitting the struggle. Not downplaying the difficulty, but stating it plainly.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 分野の交差点、独自の視点ですね。
lines.en: And you brought a real original perspective to the intersection of those fields.
lines.style: Thoughtful, deliberate. A nod of recognition. Warm but not effusive — the kind of praise that lands because it's specific and genuine.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の核心、つかめない時期もありました。
lines.en: Yes. There were times I couldn't quite grasp the heart of what I was writing.
lines.style: Quiet admission. A slight inward look — he's being honest about the moments of self-doubt. Still steady, but letting the struggle show.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦後生後直後の社会、丁寧に扱いましたね。
lines.en: You handled the immediate postwar period with real care and nuance.
lines.style: Reflective, specific. A note of respect in the voice. She's seen something most readers might miss — the deliberate sensitivity in how he framed it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 下流の地域、変化、章末で論じました。
lines.en: Yes. I examined how the downstream communities changed throughout, and brought it all together at the end.
lines.style: Slight lift of pride underneath. A little more present than before — he's found solid ground talking about something that came together. Clear, direct, but with quiet confidence.
